scope: Actual connected body triangles and canonical edges near the left shoulder at bind and held wave. Edge/area expansion and triangle-centroid distance to the posed SDF distinguish coarse interpolation from a broad implicit-surface web. This is not a pass/fail beauty metric.

region.rule: Left-side triangle centroid within 4.25 arm radii of shoulder and medial to elbow minus 0.15 radius; underarm lies more than 0.15 radius below shoulder.
